## English

### Native internals cleanup

No API or behavior changes. The JavaScript SDK, the JS bridge, the native host APIs (`configure` / `prepareBundle`), server requests and persisted state are unchanged.

- Android: native methods are now registered at library load time, so the native library exports a single entry point instead of one symbol per method. The library file is renamed from `librnupdate.so` to `librnpushy.so`. If your `packagingOptions` / `jniLibs` rules name `librnupdate.so` explicitly, update them.
- iOS: the shared C/C++ core is built as its own `Core` subspec with hidden symbol visibility, so a dynamic-framework integration no longer exports the core's internal symbols. Run `pod install` as part of the normal native upgrade.
- All platforms: internal class, method and log names were made consistent, and built-in service addresses and protocol constants are no longer stored as plain strings in the binary.
- Rebuild the native app to pick up these changes; a JS-only update is not needed and has no effect on them.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/reactnativecn/react-native-update/compare/v10.59.0...v10.59.1)

## 中文

### 原生内部整理

没有接口或行为变化。JS SDK、JS 桥接、原生宿主接口（`configure` / `prepareBundle`）、服务端请求和持久化状态均不变。

- Android：native 方法改为在库加载时注册，原生库对外只导出一个入口，不再每个方法一个符号。库文件由 `librnupdate.so` 改名为 `librnpushy.so`；如果你的 `packagingOptions` / `jniLibs` 配置里写了 `librnupdate.so`，请同步修改。
- iOS：共用的 C/C++ 核心拆为独立的 `Core` subspec，并隐藏符号可见性，以动态 framework 集成时不再导出核心内部符号。按正常原生升级流程重新运行 `pod install`。
- 三端：内部类名、方法名和日志措辞统一；内置服务地址和协议常量不再以明文字符串存放在二进制中。
- 需要重新构建原生应用才会生效；这些改动与 JS 热更新无关。

[完整变更记录](https://github.com/reactnativecn/react-native-update/compare/v10.59.0...v10.59.1)
